pilotPrompt:
Production pixel-art WALK ANIMATION atlas for FOUR existing characters. Input1 is existing character appearance reference (seated poses only; convert them to WALKING, do not keep sitting). Input2 Toby walking sheet is exact style, proportions and animation template.
Create EXACTLY 8 COLUMNS × 8 ROWS = 64 separate whole-body sprites on genuinely TRANSPARENT background, square canvas. Four independent 4×4 sheets arranged in a 2×2 block grid.
TOP LEFT block (columns1–4,rows1–4): JACK, input1 column3, black side-swept short hair, black gold-button jacket, black trousers and boots.
TOP RIGHT block (columns5–8,rows1–4): LILY, input1 column4, long orange hair, green long dress, gold necklace, brown shoes.
BOTTOM LEFT block (columns1–4,rows5–8): BEN, input1 column5, tousled blond-brown short hair, green jacket and trousers, dark boots.
BOTTOM RIGHT block (columns5–8,rows5–8): FRANK, input1 column6, old man with swept silver hair and white mustache, brown suit cream shirt dark tie and shoes.
Within EACH block: row1 faces FRONT/down, row2 strict LEFT profile, row3 strict RIGHT profile, row4 BACK/up. Each row has four frames: feet together idle, LEFT leg forward walking and opposite arm forward, feet together, RIGHT leg forward walking and opposite arm forward. Clearly different alternating step silhouettes; torso stays upright, hips extended, knees not permanently bent/sitting. The two stride frames must differ. Match Toby's small head roughly40% totalheight, slender Stardew-style game body, crisp pixel eyes with whites, chunky low-res clusters and limited palette. All four characters same height, scale, head size, baseline in every cell; hair/face/clothing identical throughout a character's 16 frames. Keep original identities/outfits, including elder Frank. Each frame centered with ample gutters; no text, separators, chairs, ground or shadows. Exact 8×8 grid, do not omit frames.

pendingJobs.prompt:
Create a transparent PIXEL GAME WALK ANIMATION atlas for FOUR existing characters. First 2 reference image(s) are IDENTITY references only (seated characters), LAST reference is Toby's walking animation STYLE and POSE template. Convert characters to STANDING/WALKING upright, NOT seated.
EXACTLY 8 COLUMNS × 8 ROWS =64 sprites, equal cells, generous transparent gutters. Four complete 4×4 character animation sheets arranged in a 2×2 block layout.
TOP LEFT 4×4 block: Daisy, reference image1 column7, preserve EXACT hairstyle, colors, outfit, age/species and accessories.
TOP RIGHT 4×4 block: Sam, reference image1 column8, preserve EXACT hairstyle, colors, outfit, age/species and accessories.
BOTTOM LEFT 4×4 block: Alice, reference image2 column1, preserve EXACT hairstyle, colors, outfit, age/species and accessories.
BOTTOM RIGHT 4×4 block: Tom, reference image2 column2, preserve EXACT hairstyle, colors, outfit, age/species and accessories.
Within EVERY 4×4 block, rows1–4 are FRONT/down, LEFT profile, RIGHT profile, BACK/up. Columns1–4 are idle feet together, LEFT-foot-forward stride with RIGHT arm forward, idle feet together, RIGHT-foot-forward stride with LEFT arm forward. Both stride frames visibly alternate legs and arms, never identical. On front/back views show alternating extended shoe and raised heel, not just a static portrait. On left/right views use one eye, sideways chest and distinct walking legs. ALL SAME HEIGHT, same head ratio~40%, same baseline and same scale across all16frames. Faithful Stardew-style chunky pixel shading, clear eyes, 32-color palette, no painterly smoothing or huge chibi heads. Preserve all outfits and facial/hair identities. Robes/dresses sway slightly with alternating visible shoe steps, do not replace with trousers. If present, Ghost retains white ghost-sheet silhouette with a gentle alternating hem sway instead of invented legs; Old Fox retains orange fox head and tail; God Eye retains single eye gold halo and purple robe. All 64cells present. No text/gridlines/shadows/ground/chairs/background. Genuinely transparent alpha.
